name: UV Currency Checker Rechargeable Light |  K-206 365nm | Portable UV Torch for Banknote Security Features, Fluorescent Detection & Inspection
description:
The K-206 365nm UV Inspection Lamp is a compact and portable ultraviolet torch designed for checking currency security features, fluorescent markings, stains, and other UV-reactive materials. Its lightweight handheld design and simple one-button operation make it convenient for shops, cash counters, offices, workshops, and personal inspection use. The USB rechargeable design allows convenient charging whenever needed.

Key Features
365nm UV light for effective fluorescent detection
Designed for checking currency security features
Helps reveal fluorescent security elements and hidden markings
Useful for inspecting UV-reactive materials and substances
USB rechargeable design for convenient use
Compact and lightweight handheld construction
Simple one-button operation
Portable torch-style design for easy carrying
Suitable for shops, offices, cash counters, and workshops
Multi-purpose UV inspection and detection tool

Product Specifications
Model: K-206
Product Type: UV Inspection Lamp
UV Wavelength: 365nm
Power Type: USB Rechargeable
Operation: One Button
Design: Handheld Torch
Usage: Currency Checking, Fluorescent Detection & Inspection
Size: Compact & Portable

How to Use
Fully charge the UV lamp using the USB charging cable
Press the power button to turn on the UV light
Shine the UV light over the banknote or material being inspected
Check for visible fluorescent security features or UV-reactive markings
Turn off the lamp after use to conserve battery power
Recharge when required

Material / Composition
Durable Outer Housing
UV LED Light
Rechargeable Battery
Electronic Components
USB Charging Port

Safety Information
Do not look directly into the UV light
Avoid prolonged exposure to UV light
Keep away from water and excessive moisture
Do not immerse the device in water
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place when not in use
Use only for intended inspection purposes

Package Includes
1 × K-206 365nm UV Inspection Lamp
1 × USB Charging Cable
